svg.title: FG-I2: From a circle to sine and cosine
svg.desc: The graph horizontal axis is angle, not the circle point’s horizontal coordinate. Static design sketch showing two selected states. Read the learning plan for the full interaction.
svg.text: FG-I2 / From a circle to sine and cosine
ANNOTATED DESIGN SKETCH · selected states, not a production screen
Circle height becomes the graph output
The input is an angle; the output is height
Follow the same coordinate below the axis.
The graph horizontal axis is angle, not the circle point’s horizontal coordinate.
